Rec Room

Apr 11, 2025 Hi, I'm Diana Apr 11, 2025 Hi, I'm Diana

Project Description

Rec Room is an online cross-platform multiplayer game that blends UGC with interactive social experiences. Players can connect in a wide range of virtual spaces, from hangout rooms to co-op quests.

Platforms

Steam, PC Standalone, iOS, Android, Quest VR, Xbox, PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch

Contribution: Senior Gameplay Engineer

Currently senior gameplay engineer on the Retention team. Responsible for overseeing large projects by delegating work, quantifying risk, and choosing technical design. Mentors junior engineers and ensures team’s code quality is at a high level through TDD and PR reviews.

A few projects that I was the dev owner of are:

Contribution: Gameplay Engineer

Improved our player inventory system by adding item tags and customizable hotbar that integrated with the inventory UI and UGC ecosystem. Added UGC player progression system for Make it to Midnight. Updated several UI pages to newer UI redesign.

Contribution: Tools Engineer

Joined the Rec Room team as a tools engineer. Developed several quality of life in-game tools - fps monitoring, bug reporting tool, revamped debug command UI. Worked with the art team to design and add an art item upload editor tool to upload avatar items and consumables from their local editor to the test server.
